name: 45750 · Marietta, OH
findings: ZIP 45750 (Marietta) has 176 nonprofit organizations. 93 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 83 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45750 (Marietta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45750 (Marietta) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 83 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
